production.direction_en: The gallery contains portraits with their nameplates cut away. Mirel and Aveline arrive with the cathedral folio; Odelia's message found them. In one portrait, a court official's gloved hand rests beside a watch with no hands.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch6_estate (uneasy layer) | post: bgm_fadyme_theme + bgm_ledger_motif together on 'She was my mother.'

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: You never told me she was here.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: I was not sure I remembered her correctly.

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: Then we will remember the portrait for you.

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: Wait. The order that cut these names was copied in my hand. I was a court scribe. I never asked whose names they were.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: Then you know how easily it happens. That is not the same as choosing it.
